pleyaShare.cardSubtitle: Connect to another Pleya device sharing its media
pleyaShare.hostDescription: Other Pleya devices on this network can browse, stream, and download your local folders. Keep this screen open while sharing.
pleyaShare.hostDescriptionIos: Other Pleya devices on this network can browse, stream, and download your local folders. Sharing keeps running while your device is locked.
pleyaShare.howItWorksBody:
One device is the server: it shares its local folders. Other Pleya devices pair once with the QR code or the 6-digit code and can then browse, stream, and download from it.

• On newer devices (iOS 26+, most Android phones) devices also find each other directly via Wi-Fi Aware, with no hotspot or router at all.
• Works over Wi-Fi, a personal hotspot, or a cable: ethernet adapters, or USB-C with USB tethering enabled on the host (Android, or iPhone to a computer). Direct iPhone-to-iPad over USB is not supported by iOS. No internet needed.
• With internet on both devices, streaming also works remotely through the encrypted Pleya relay.
• Paired devices reconnect automatically — pairing is needed only once.
• Watch progress and artwork sync with your Plex or Jellyfin account when available.

settings.providerHeading: Choose where Big P gets its language model
settings.ollamaServerDescription: Runs on your own network, for example on your NAS.
settings.ollamaCloudDescription: Models that Ollama runs for you.
settings.openRouterDescription: One key for models from several vendors.
settings.dataNote: Your question goes to the provider, with the names of libraries, servers and users needed to answer it. Passwords and tokens stay in Pleya.
settings.headerHelp: Only needed when the server sits behind a reverse proxy that asks for its own header.
settings.modelsHelp: Only models that can use tools are listed.
settings.noToolModels: No models here can use tools. Install or pick one that can.
settings.modelMissing: The chosen model is no longer available.
settings.disableBody: The provider and key are removed from this device. You can set Big P up again at any time.
settings.unreadableBody: Your iCloud keychain holds a Big P setup from a newer Pleya version on another device. This version cannot read it. Replacing it changes the setup on all your devices.
settings.errorUrlInvalid: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
settings.errorHeaderInvalid: This header name or value is not valid.
settings.errorUnreachable: Server not reachable. Check the address and, for https, the certificate.
settings.errorTimeout: The server did not answer in time.
settings.errorBadResponse: Unexpected answer from the server. Check the address.
settings.savedModelGone: ${model} is no longer offered. Pick another model below.
settings.pullErrorUnknown: Ollama no longer has this model in its library. Pick another model.
settings.pullErrorDisk: Not enough disk space on the server to update the model.
settings.ollamaWebKeyHelp: Without this key Big P searches Wikipedia only.
settings.webSearchNoteServer: Off by default, so everything stays on your network. When on, the description of a title you look for goes to Wikipedia and, with an ollama.com key, to Ollama's web search.
settings.webSearchNoteCloud: The description of a title you look for goes to Wikipedia and Ollama's web search.
settings.webSearchNoteOpenRouter: The description of a title you look for goes to Wikipedia and OpenRouter's web search, which costs roughly 0.005 to 0.007 dollars per search.
settings.voiceNote: Short spoken reactions. Never while you dictate or watch something.
settings.factsOnlineNote: Big P then adds the age rating, genres, runtime, cast, score and streaming services of a title from TMDB, Trakt, TVmaze and Wikidata. Only the title or the title's ids go to those services, never your account or profile. With the switch off, Big P uses only your server and Seerr.
settings.tmdbKeyHelp: Free to request at themoviedb.org (Settings > API). Paste the 'API Read Access Token'. Seerr has its own TMDB, so Big P also works without a key, with fewer details.
settings.kidsProfileNote: Big P only shows titles that suit the children's ages. Only for this profile, only on this device.
settings.kidsProfileLocked: Plex marks this account as restricted, so this is always on.
